name: dsh-pc-pilot
description: PC-Pilot - DeepSeek Harness Windows 桌面操作插件：UIA 无障碍树、PrintWindow 截图、后台合成光标输入（UIA Pattern / 窗口消息）与真实 SendInput，AI 窗口可停泊在一块真实的虚拟显示器（IddCx Virtual Display Driver）上隐形运行，配合苹果风格画中画悬浮窗实时镜像工作区，一条命令即可完成虚拟屏安装。Windows computer-use host plugin for DeepSeek Harness: UIA accessibility tree, PrintWindow screenshots, background synthetic-cursor input (UIA patterns / window messages) and real SendInput, with AI windows parked on a real IddCx virtual display and an Apple-style PiP overlay mirroring it live.
